payload.decision: Reject H028/T036 and close candidate-wise summary, pointwise-loss, pairwise-ranking, and soft top-k selection over the T033 pair dictionary. Select H029/T037 as one materially independent bounded mechanism: full row-level candidate-conditioned emissions decoded on the deduplicated union path graph.
payload.rationale: T036 preserves the 4.628457 candidate oracle but the legal selector reaches 12.472865 RMSE, retains only 0.983% of oracle gain, wins 0/5 maps and 7/25 cells, fails legacy and tail gates, and beats action priors by only 0.092333 RMSE. Its 39-feature candidate summary compression may discard local emission structure; a graph decoder asks a different question while keeping an exact sub-5 admissible-path capacity identity. The non-genuine duplicate-action control is frozen evidence against soft selection and is corrected structurally in T037 by exact pre-decoding path deduplication, not by post-result repair of T036.
payload.revisit_trigger: Do not reopen T036 families. Continue beyond T037 only if the full-emission decoder passes its frozen legal, transfer, tail, resource, and evidence-destruction gates.
payload.title: Close candidate summary ranking and test full-emission structured decoding
